_comment: EXAMPLE live-video (HLS) source pack — VERIFY BEFORE USE.
_what: Template for pointing the CCTV layer at genuinely live public-sector traffic-camera HLS streams (US state DOT / 511 systems). This pseudo-entry has no id, so the server-side loader skips it.
_how: 1) Pick cameras from your state's 511/DOT site and confirm each stream URL plays (curl the .m3u8; VLC or ffprobe the stream). 2) Replace the example entries below with your verified cameras. 3) Run with CCTV_SOURCES_FILE=config/cctv_sources.<yourpack>.json (add CCTV_FORCE_AUSTIN=1 to keep the live city packs alongside). See .env.example.
_rules: Every video entry MUST carry a snapshotUrl still image — without one, /api/cctv/frame falls through to the metered Google Street View fallback. Use only streams the operator publishes for public consumption, avoid tokenized/expiring URLs, respect each DOT's terms, and record provider + license per entry (see DATA_SOURCES.md). Cross-origin CDN segments are dropped by the proxy's manifest rewriter — prefer streams whose segments live on the manifest's own host.
_pose: headingDeg/pitchDeg/fovDeg/rangeM/mountHeightM/groundElevationM are estimated priors — calibrate in-app by dragging the camera gizmo; poseSource 'curated' shows the CAL badge.
_verified: The example URLs below follow each system's documented pattern but are NOT live-verified in this repo — they are placeholders for the shape, not a curated catalog.
